paragraphs.text:
CAIRO T AXIS
On the few main streets of Cairo, cabs of every variety, from sleek 
new Packards to old Fords running on makeshift parts, can be 
found. You can hire a driver to stay with you for the day, or you 
can walk (each trip to a location costs an extra hour). Go to any 
Cairo location on the Egypt Location Table.
(Egypt Location)
